power.jaymospowers.arsenal.desc: Reach into other dimensions and pull out whatever weapon answers. Summoned weapons return to their dimension after a while.
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.ability_4: Rift Chains: three rifts open around what you aim at (up to 24 blocks) and chains hold it where it stands, even in the air (4 s, 2 s for a player); press %4$s again and the chains drag it to your feet
Sword of Damocles: a great rift opens in the sky above you; 3 s later a 16-block sword falls through, smashing what's below and driving into the ground (G calls it back early)
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.mode: Pocket Dimension: a rift opens in front of you; walk into it to reach your own room to build in (inside, it leads back out where you left). Press again to close it. Friends who walk in after you follow
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.mode.name: Pocket Dimension
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.special: Cannon Battery: hold %7$s and cannons push out of rifts behind you, one more the longer you hold (up to 10); they follow your crosshair and all fire when you let go
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.ultimate: Hundred Blades: rifts rain weapons where you aim
item.jaymospowers.arsenal_dimensional_ke: Cut for a lock you already carry.
It will not turn for an unpractised hand.
tooltip.jaymospowers.arsenal.summoned: Summoned: returns to its dimension in %ss
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.chains_noth: Nothing there for the chains to hold
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.chains_boun: Chains out of the rift hold you fast
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.nothing_to_: You aren't holding a summoned weapon
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.ultimate_no: There is nothing there to fall on
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.damocles_no: There is no ground below you for the sword to strike
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.damocles_re: The rift opens to take the sword back
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.whisper_1: Something on the other side of the rift turns its head.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.whisper_2: The rift is colder than it was.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.whisper_3: They are learning the way through.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.whisper_end: The void was waiting for you.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.purge_start: Its death is pulling something out of you.
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.starter: Rummage: reach in and see what turns up
item.jaymospowers.arsenal_relic.lore: It hums, as if it remembers being somewhere else.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.relic_kept: %s slips into the Rift Hoard in your pocket. It's yours now.
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.ability_3: Void Gates: %3$s fixes a gate where you aim (up to 5); Sneak + %3$s steps through to the one you aim at (looking down, it opens your pocket, letting you in at a gate fixed inside); hold %3$s on one of your gates to close it; hold Sneak + %3$s with none to cast one ahead
message.jaymospowers.arsenal_gate_too_fa: Nothing there for a gate to hold to.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal_gate_blocke: Something stands where the gate opens.
item.jaymospowers.durandal.lore1: Drawn from the stone it was driven into.
item.jaymospowers.durandal.lore2: A relic: the rift keeps it for whoever drew it.
message.jaymospowers.sword_stone.stuck: It won't budge. It's waiting for someone the rift knows.
message.jaymospowers.sword_stone.drawn: The stone lets go. %s is yours.
item.jaymospowers.soul_saber.lore1: It drinks a little of every wound.
item.jaymospowers.soul_saber.lore2: Right click: a slash of soul fire
item.jaymospowers.grand_shield.lore1: What is thrown at it goes home.
item.jaymospowers.voidreaver.lore1: Its cut leaves nothing to see by.
item.jaymospowers.voidreaver.lore2: Right click: step behind your target
item.jaymospowers.tidebreaker.lore1: Heavier in the rain, like the sea.
item.jaymospowers.sunfang.lore1: Hot as the sand it was buried in.
item.jaymospowers.sunfang.lore2: Right click: a blast of scouring sand
item.jaymospowers.flintlock.lore: One shot. Drop it spent; another is already in your hand.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.void_faded: Three days on, the void loses its grip on you. It's gone.
item.jaymospowers.laevateinn.lore1: Still warm from the fire it was forged in.
item.jaymospowers.caladbolg.lore1: Thin as starlight, and as cold.
item.jaymospowers.gram.lore1: It hums with something listening in the dark.
item.jaymospowers.hrunting.lore1: Frost never quite melts from its edge.
item.jaymospowers.durandal.passive: Unbreakable. Its bearer can't be knocked back.
item.jaymospowers.durandal.active: Right click: Plant, a staggering shockwave
item.jaymospowers.laevateinn.passive: Sets what it cuts alight. Its bearer doesn't burn.
item.jaymospowers.laevateinn.active: Right click: Flame Wave, an arc of fire
item.jaymospowers.caladbolg.passive: Each cut arcs on to two more foes.
item.jaymospowers.caladbolg.active: Right click: Rainbow Reach, one long sweep
item.jaymospowers.gram.passive: Bites through armour, and harder still against the great.
item.jaymospowers.gram.active: Right click: Sunder, wrecking armour and shields
item.jaymospowers.hrunting.passive: Frost creeps into what it cuts.
item.jaymospowers.hrunting.active: Right click: Frost Lance, a spear of ice that comes back
item.jaymospowers.void_crown.lore1: It was never made for a head. It was made for a hollow.
item.jaymospowers.void_crown.lore2: Struck, you are elsewhere. Endermen meet your eyes as kin.
tooltip.jaymospowers.void_crown.cold: It is cold in your hands. It is not waiting for you.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.crown_found: Something else came through behind it.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.crown_refus: It will not sit on your brow.
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.crown_slips: The crown lets go of you.
power.jaymospowers.arsenal.key.ability_1: Reach Through (your pinned weapon first). Sneak + %1$s: pin the held weapon (empty hand: unpin)
Reach Through: void-touched, pinned first, sometimes flintlocks. Sneak + %1$s: pin (empty hand: unpin)
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.pocket_ente: Your pocket. The ender chest is your Rift Hoard; walk into the portal by the door (or press Z) to step out
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.pocket_visi: Someone else's pocket. Walk into the portal by the door to step out
message.jaymospowers.arsenal.pocket_not_: This hoard isn't yours to open
